column1: # BabelSoft Script Data: Yi transliteration tables
#   One block per table; the line after [name] names that block's columns.
#   Syllables are U+XXXX codepoints; the initial/medial/final columns are
#   decimal indices into the Latin initial/medial/final tables.
#   syllable: one row per Yi syllable in U+A000..U+A48B order.
#   index: the syllables are sorted by initial, so row N is the first syllable
#     of initial group N (group N spans [syllable_N, syllable_(N+1))).
#   radical: the Latin name of each of the 55 Yi radicals, in radical order.
